beats.headline: A pump and a tin can
beats.text: Prepotente spends his wand's tiny three-minute safe space opening his loot boxes, which Carl thinks is a waste. Ten seconds before it closes, his legendary benefactor box gives up two items. One looks like a handheld bicycle pump with a tin can welded under the nozzle; Donut says it is like one of Bea's perfume bottles, and Carl recognises a sprayer for putting herbicide on a garden. The other is a piece of paper. Prepotente wants five fine healing potions from Carl, payment for the Size Up scrolls Carl stole from his mother, and Carl makes him tell what is on the paper first: fine healing, blessed water and a weedkiller, applied as a very fine mist through the new canister.

beats.headline: Mordecai builds on it
beats.text: A System message: another Odious Creeper has fallen, credit to Crawler Prepotente, forty remain. That is his third, says Carl. On the counter, Mordecai has four moonshine jugs of his own weedkiller, built on what Prepotente said and what he received: a weedkiller designed to take out an odious bloom, with several anti-undead boosts added, like the holy grenade he once made for Carl.
